author: Arcani test fixtures
rationale: Smooth swell fixture (Story 2.3): 5 s. Theta reference: 450 Hz carrier amplitude-modulated at 6 Hz by the sine envelope, 75 percent AM depth. Gamma PAC layer: 250 Hz sine carrier amplitude-modulated at 40 Hz, its AM depth a smooth swell peaking at 100 percent at the 0 degree coupling phase of the theta reference. Both the same in both channels; together they can peak near 2.0, so the 24-bit WAV can clip. Values are placeholders, not starter defaults. A test fixture, not for listening.
